name: Wheel of Innocence
source:
Wheel of Innocence is a linear visual novel where you occasionally help Reina open up to herself and those around her by picking choices throughout the story. Learn more about the dark past of not just Reina but another close to her as well.

Reina is currently in her last year at a new high school due to severe bullying from the last school she attended and hopes to finish it with little issues. A few days into the new year she is introduced to a volunteer assistant named Mizuki.  

During the rest of the first semester, they both go on adventures and become close friends with something more sprouting but soon problems start happening which they will need to resolve together or alone.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2180010/Wheel_of_Innocence/]Steam main page[/url]]
translation:
《Wheel of Innocence》是一部线性视觉小说。玩家可以在故事中做出选择，偶尔帮助Reina敞开心扉，面对自己和身边的人。你不仅会逐渐了解Reina黑暗的过去，也会揭开她一位亲近之人的往事。

Reina曾在上一所学校遭受严重霸凌，因此转学来到新高中，如今正读最后一年，希望能平静地完成学业。新年开学几天后，她认识了一位名叫Mizuki的志愿助理。

第一学期剩下的日子里，两人一起经历种种事情，成为亲密的朋友，彼此之间也萌生了更深的感情。但不久后，麻烦接踵而至，她们必须独自或携手解决问题。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2180010/Wheel_of_Innocence/]Steam主页[/url]]
